title: NeuraVision Research Lab — Computer Vision & Deep Learning, Bilkent University
meta_description: NeuraVision is a computer vision and deep learning research lab at Bilkent University, led by Dr. Doruk Öner. We work on topological deep learning, curvilinear structure delineation, uncertainty estimation, trustworthy AI, and medical image analysis.
